testNames: fits to independent extents and sets every run and paragraph end while retaining other formatting
rows.rationale: Original supplied advances produce an independently computed 20pt layout including the final explicit break. Verifies text retention, run/field/break/end-paragraph fonts, wrap=true and autofit=NONE; source font-dependent 10/11pt expectation is replaced with deterministic original geometry, not copied.

testNames: rejects absent fonts, missing metrics and impossible minimum size without mutation
rows.rationale: Security mapping: admitted exact-family/style metrics replace host file discovery. Missing metrics/font/glyphs fail explicitly; no host paths, platform file search or ambient fallback.

testNames: fits through the public SDK and command with equal bytes and independent expected size
rows.rationale: Original 38.4pt by 47.2pt shape minus 7.2pt horizontal and 3.6pt vertical insets yields 24pt by 40pt. Independent AA AA metrics yield two lines at 20pt; 21pt exceeds height.

api.sourceSignature: (self, font_family: str='Calibri', max_size: int=18, bold: bool=False, italic: bool=False, font_file: str | None=None)
api.mapping: Retains positional font_family=Calibri, max_size=18, bold=false, italic=false, font_file?:FontMetricsHandle|null and void return. Optional sixth ModelTextFitOptions supplies minSize, margins, wrap and lineSpacing. Detached TextFrame constructor accepts explicit point extents; package fitting derives local shape extents. No host font discovery; whole owner-graph API remains pending. CLI text.fit admits metric JSON and calls fitTextFrames; SDK admission is admitFontMetrics(data).
api.targetSignature: fit_text(font_family?: string, max_size?: number, bold?: boolean, italic?: boolean, font_file?: FontMetricsHandle | null, options?: ModelTextFitOptions): void
